H4700.def: from «06750»; (only dual) double tinklers, i.e. cymbals:--cymbals.

H4701.def: from «06801»; a tiara, i.e. official turban (of a king or high priest):--diadem, mitre.

H4703.def: from «06805»; a step; figuratively, companionship:--going, step.

H4704.def: feminine of «04705»; properly, littleness; concretely, diminutive:--little.

H4705.def: from «06819»; petty (in size or number); adverbially, a short (time):--little one (while), small.

H4706.def: the same as «04705»; Mitsar, a peak of Lebanon:--Mizar.

H4707.def: from «06822»; an observatory, especially for military purposes:--watch tower.

H4708.def: the same as «04707»; Mitspeh, the name of five places in Palestine:--Mizpeh, watch tower. Compare «04709».

H4709.def: feminine of «04708»; Mitspah, the name of two places in Palestine:--Mitspah. (This seems rather to be only an orthographic variation of «04708» when "in pause".)

H4710.def: from «06845»; a secret (place or thing, perhaps, treasure):--hidden thing.

H4712.def: from «06896»; something tight, i.e. (figuratively) trouble:--distress, pain, strait.

H4713.def: from «04714»; a Mitsrite, or inhabitant of Mitsrajim:--Egyptian, of Egypt.

H4714.def: dual of «04693»; Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt:--Egypt, Egyptians, Mizraim.

H4716.def: from «04743»; properly, a melting, i.e. putridity:-- rottenness, stink.

H4717.def: from «05344»; properly, a perforatrix, i.e. a hammer (as piercing):--hammer.

H4718.def: from «05344»; properly, a perforator, i.e. a hammer (as piercing); also (intransitively) a perforation, i.e. a quarry:--hammer, hole.

H4719.et: from the same as (05348) in the denominative sense of herding (compare (05349))
H4719.def: from the same as «05348» in the denominative sense of herding (compare «05349»); fold; Makkedah, a place in Palestine:-- Makkedah.

H4720.def: or miqqdash (Exod. 15:17) {mik-ked-awsh'}; from «06942»; a consecrated thing or place, especially, a palace, sanctuary (whether of Jehovah or of idols) or asylum:--chapel, hallowed part, holy place, sanctuary.

H4722.def: plural of «04721» (feminine); assemblies; Makheloth, a place in the Desert:--Makheloth.

H4723.def: or miqveh (1 Kings 10:28) {mik-vay'}; or miqvet (2 Chron. 1:16) {mik-vay'}; from «06960»; something waited for, i.e. confidence (objective or subjective); also a collection, i.e. (of water) a pond, or (of men and horses) a caravan or drove:--abiding, gathering together, hope, linen yarn, plenty (of water), pool.

H4724.def: feminine of «04723»; a collection, i.e. (of water) a reservoir:--ditch.

H4725.def: or maqom {maw-kome'}; also (feminine) mqowmah {mek-o-mah'}; or mqomah {mek-o-mah'}; from «06965»; properly, a standing, i.e. a spot; but used widely of a locality (general or specific); also (figuratively) of a condition (of body or mind):--country, × home, × open, place, room, space, × whither(-soever).

H4726.def: or maqor {maw-kore'}; from «06979»; properly, something dug, i.e. a (general) source (of water, even when naturally flowing; also of tears, blood (by euphemism, of the female pudenda); figuratively, of happiness, wisdom, progeny):--fountain, issue, spring, well(-spring).

H4729.def: from «06999»; something to fume (incense) on i.e. a hearth place:--to burn...upon.

H4730.def: feminine of «04729»; something to fume (incense) in, i.e. a coal-pan:--censer.

H4731.et: from an unused root meaning apparently to germinate
H4731.def: or (feminine) maqqlah {mak-kel-aw'}; from an unused root meaning apparently to germinate; a shoot, i.e. stick (with leaves on, or for walking, striking, guiding, divining):--rod, ((hand- ))staff.

H4732.def: (or perhaps mik-kel-ohth') plural of (feminine) «04731»; rods; Mikloth, a place in the Desert:--Mikloth.

H4733.et: from (07038) in the sense of taking in
H4733.def: from «07038» in the sense of taking in; an asylum (as a receptacle):--refuge.

H4734.def: from «07049»; a sculpture (probably in bas-relief):--carved (figure), carving, graving.

H4735.def: from «07069»; something bought, i.e. property, but only livestock; abstractly, acquisition:--cattle, flock, herd, possession, purchase, substance.

H4736.def: feminine of «04735»; properly, a buying, i.e. acquisition; concretely, a piece of property (land or living); also the sum paid:--(he that is) bought, possession, piece, purchase.

H4737.def: from «04735» and «03050»; possession of Jah; Miknejah, an Israelite:--Mikneiah.

H4739.def: from «07112»; end; Makats, a place in Palestine:--Makaz.

H4740.et: from (07106) in the denominative sense of bending
H4740.def: or maqtsoa {mak-tso-ah}; or (feminine) maqtso-ah {mak-tso-aw'}; from «07106» in the denominative sense of bending; an angle or recess:--corner, turning.

H4741.def: from «07106»; a scraper, i.e. a carving chisel:--plane.

H4742.et: from (07106) in the denominative sense of bending
H4742.def: from «07106» in the denominative sense of bending; an angle:--corner.

H4743.def: ' a primitive root; to melt; figuratively, to flow, dwindle, vanish:--consume away, be corrupt, dissolve, pine away.

H4744.def: from «07121»; something called out, i.e. a public meeting (the act, the persons, or the place); also a rehearsal:--assembly, calling, convocation, reading.

H4745.def: from «07136»; something met with, i.e. an accident or fortune:--something befallen, befalleth, chance, event, hap(-peneth).

H4746.def: from «07136»; properly, something meeting, i.e. a frame (of timbers):--building.

H4747.def: from the same as «07119»; a cooling off:--X summer.

H4748.et: from (07185) in the sense of knotting up round and hard
H4748.def: from «07185» in the sense of knotting up round and hard; something turned (rounded), i.e. a curl (of tresses):--X well (set) hair.

H4749.def: feminine of «04748»; rounded work, i.e. moulded by hammering (repousse):--beaten (out of one piece, work), upright, whole piece.

H4750.def: denominative from «07180»; literally, a cucumbered field, i.e. a cucumber patch:--garden of cucumbers.

H4751.def: or (feminine) marah {maw-raw'}; from «04843»; bitter (literally or figuratively); also (as noun) bitterness, or (adverbially) bitterly:--+ angry, bitter(-ly, -ness), chafed, discontented, × great, heavy.

H4752.et: from (04843) in its original sense of distillation
H4752.def: from «04843» in its original sense of distillation; a drop:--drop.

H4753.def: or mowr {more}; from «04843»; myrrh (as distilling in drops, and also as bitter):--myrrh.

H4754.def: a primitive root; to rebel; hence (through the idea of maltreating) to whip, i.e. lash (self with wings, as the ostrich in running):--be filthy, lift up self.

H4755.def: for «04751» feminine; bitter; Mara, a symbolic name of Naomi:--Mara.

H4756.et: from a root corresponding to (04754) in the sense of domineering
H4756.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «04754» in the sense of domineering; a master:--lord, Lord.

H4757.def: of foreign derivation; Merodak-Baladan, a Babylonian king:--Merodach-baladan. Compare «04781».

H4758.def: from «07200»; a view (the act of seeing); also an appearance (the thing seen), whether (real) a shape (especially if handsome, comeliness; often plural the looks), or (mental) a vision:--X apparently, appearance(-reth), × as soon as beautiful(-ly), countenance, fair, favoured, form, goodly, to look (up) on (to), look(-eth), pattern, to see, seem, sight, visage, vision.

H4759.def: feminine of «04758»; a vision; also (causatively) a mirror:--looking glass, vision.

H4760.def: apparently feminine passive causative participle of «07200»; something conspicuous, i.e. the craw of a bird (from its prominence):--crop.

H4761.def: denominative from «07218»; properly, headship, i.e. (plural for collective) dominion:--principality.

H4762.def: or Mareshah {mar-ay-shaw'}; formed like «04761»; summit; Mareshah, the name of two Israelites and of a place in Palestine:--Mareshah.

H4763.def: formed like «04761»; properly, a headpiece, i.e. (plural for adverbial) at (or as) the head-rest (or pillow):--bolster, head, pillow. Compare «04772».

H4764.def: from «07231»; increase; Merab, a daughter of Saul:--Merab.

H4766.def: from «07235»; properly, increasing; as noun, greatness, or (adverbially) greatly:--great, increase.

H4767.def: from «07235»; abundance, i.e. a great quantity:--much.

H4768.def: from «07235»; a multitude; also offspring; specifically interest (on capital):--greatest part, greatness, increase, multitude.

H4769.def: from «07257»; a reclining place, i.e. fold (for flocks):--couching place, place to lie down.

H4770.et: from an unused root meaning to tie up
H4770.def: from an unused root meaning to tie up; a stall (for cattle):--X fat(-ted), stall.

H4772.def: denominative from «07272»; (plural for collective) a footpiece, i.e. (adverbially) at the foot, or (direct.) the foot itself:--feet. Compare «04763».

H4776.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «04775»; rebellion:--rebellion.

H4778.def: the same as «04777»; Mered, an Israelite:--Mered.

H4781.def: of foreign derivation; Merodak, a Babylonian idol:--Merodach. Compare «04757».

H4782.def: of foreign derivation; Mordecai, an Israelite:--Mordecai.

H4784.def: a primitive root; to be (causatively, make) bitter (or unpleasant); (figuratively) to rebel (or resist; causatively, to provoke):--bitter, change, be disobedient, disobey, grievously, provocation, provoke(-ing), (be) rebel (against, -lious).

H4785.def: the same as «04751» feminine; bitter; Marah, a place in the Desert:--Marah.

H4788.et: from (07300) in the sense of maltreatment
H4788.def: from «07300» in the sense of maltreatment; an outcast; (abstractly) destitution:--cast out, misery.

H4789.def: of uncertain derivation; Meroz, a place in Palestine:--Meroz.

H4791.def: from «07311»; altitude, i.e. concretely (an elevated place), abstractly (elevation, figuratively (elation), or adverbially (aloft):--(far) above, dignity, haughty, height, (most, on) high (one, place), loftily, upward.

H4792.def: formed like «04791»; height; Merom, a lake in Palestine:--Merom.

H4793.def: from «07323»; a run (the trial of speed):--race.

H4794.def: or mrutsah {mer-oo-tsaw'}; feminine of «04793»; a race (the act), whether the manner or the progress:--course, running. Compare «04835».

H4795.def: from «04838»; properly, rubbed; but used abstractly, a rubbing (with perfumery):--purification.

H4796.def: plural of «04751» feminine; bitter springs; Maroth, a place in Palestine:--Maroth.

H4797.et: from an unused root meaning to scream
H4797.def: from an unused root meaning to scream; a cry, i.e. (of job), a revel:--banquet.

H4798.def: formed like «04797»; a cry, i.e. (of grief) a lamentation:--mourning.

H4799.def: a primitive root; properly, to soften by rubbing or pressure; hence (medicinally) to apply as an emollient:--lay for a plaister.
